headline: SBS reports Peruvian financial system NPL ratio drops to 3.1%
summary: Peru's financial system maintained robust solvency and liquidity indicators, with non-performing loans falling to 3.1%, the lowest level in a decade, according to the SBS.
why: Banking system delinquency ratios reflect the credit quality of household and corporate loan portfolios and overall financial stability.

impacts.name: Banking Sector
impacts.why: Lower default rates improve asset quality and profitability prospects for commercial lenders.
